title: Steady power
summary: Geothermal Taps on vents and Tidal Generators offshore give power day and night.
text:
Solar and batteries will carry a small colony, but steady power that ignores the sun makes nights much easier: the depots keep mining in the dark.

- **Geothermal Tap**: strong, steady power, but only built on top of a **geothermal vent** (look for the steaming vents in the ground). A Relay Tower helps you reach one outside your build area
- **Tidal Generator**: a little steady power from turbines in the current. It's built out on the water, so only on coasts
- **Fusion Cell**: the heaviest of all, after research, as long as it has isotopes to burn

Spare steady power is also what a Matter Printer runs on.
